title: Production certification bound identity
description: The complete identity a certification stamp is bound to. Every field is required and no additional field is tolerated: an unknown field means the deployed thing changed in a way this program cannot reason about, which must fail closed rather than silently preserve a stamp. This schema describes PRIVATE or LOCAL identity exports only; no populated identity document is ever committed to the product branch.

fullGitSha.description: Full backend source SHA. An abbreviated SHA is not an identity.

imageDigest.description: Immutable container image digest shared by the production candidate and the certification twin.

configDigest.description: Digest of the strict normalized service configuration comparison.

scenarioRegistryDigest.description: Lowercase SHA-256 of the canonical in-image scenario_registry.json bytes.

promptDigest.description: Digest of the exact prompt text submitted for model-dependent scenarios.

requestedModel.description: Model identifier requested by the worker.

resolvedModel.description: Provider-returned response.model. A mutable alias that resolves differently invalidates the stamp.

modelFingerprint.description: Stable provider fingerprint bound to each run and stamp.

dependencyDigest.description: Digest of the hash-locked dependency graph baked into the image.

fixtureConfigSecretVersion.description: Immutable numeric fixture-config secret version. Concrete client, recipient, Sheet, Drive, thread, and event identities come only from this bound secret, never from the registry or the request.

crossRepoAnchors.description: Exact source anchors for both repositories. A frontend adapter change invalidates backend stamps that depended on it.
